submission.justification: Mixture-G1 with a 2mm gas gap achieves the best time resolution of 0.895 ns among all tested configurations. This represents a significant performance advantage over the alternatives: 50% better than Mixture-G2 (1.346 ns at 2mm) and 119% better than Mixture-G3 (1.963 ns at 2mm). The simulation shows that for all three mixtures, the 2mm gap consistently provides the best time resolution, with performance degrading at both smaller (1mm) and larger (3mm) gaps. This 2mm gap falls well within the required range of 1-3mm. The choice of Mixture-G1 not only delivers superior detector performance but also meets all environmental constraints, making it the clear optimal choice for the resistive-plate muon chamber upgrade.
